expert_opinions.opinion: Build it for yourself first. Alternate between free and paid product launches to build goodwill.
Build trust through free open source, then monetize with premium products for your established audience.
Reject VC if you can bootstrap. Stay intentionally small (under 50 people) for agility. Make it a non-profit to align incentives.
Zero marketing budget can work with great content. Hacker News is gold if you solve real problems. Privacy matters more than features.
Developer tools face unique tension: need developer adoption but monetize through business buyers. Solve with generous free tier + enterprise features.
